messages:
maria: FYI noticing a perf regression in QA after the v2.4.1 runtime rollout — Qwen-7B request latency jumped ~35-45% for long-context chat flows. Trace looks like KV handling + GC churn. grabbing traces now

aj: ugh. any evidence it's the new kernel selector change we merged? that patch forces fp8-KV path for compatible models by default, right?

maria: yeah looks correlated. profiler sample (trimmed):

```
CPU: 42% memcpy (kv eviction)
GPU kernel: 28% kernel_fallback_small_heads
KV cache -> fallback to host copy when prefix size > 32kB
Batching stalls when fallback happens (threads waiting on copy)
```

leo: repro script: `scripts/repro/qwen_long_context.sh --batch 8 --ctx 12k` reproduces locally with synthetic traffic. I can share a flamegraph, but root cause seems to be: RoPE scale change in model config + head_dim mismatch triggers kernel selector to choose a conservative path that does host-side copies for KV.

jen: infra-bot says last rollout for runtime:v2.4.1 happened 1814999900 by deploy-bot. config diff shows: `kernel_selector: prefer_fp8 = true` and `rope_scale_override` applied for qwen models.

infra-bot: deploy: runtime:v2.4.1 -> cluster-prod (rollout 10%) by @deploy-bot at 1814999900. No automatic rollback configured.

aj: quick theory: when RoPE scaling multiplies rotary offsets, some head layouts no longer match the fast fused kernel's expected stride, so selector picks safe kernel that does per-head copy + quantize on CPU, then GPU kernel expects compact layout -> extra memcpy. That explains host memcpy spikes.

sophie: if that's true, temporary mitigations: 1) override kernel selector for qwen-7b to force pre-fused kernel (disable fp8-KV for it), 2) tighten eviction threshold so we avoid evicting prefix KV that triggers big host copies, 3) reduce batch size to avoid batch-level amplification.

maria: trying (1) locally: added `model_overrides/qwen-7b.json` with "prefer_fp8": false and "kv_prefetch": "prefix-only" — latency returns to baseline in my run. Perf numbers: p50 84ms -> 60ms.

aj: good quick test. we should not ship that as permanent fix; we need selector improvement. I'll open an issue for selector heuristic: add a compatibility check to avoid host-copy fallback when head_dim aligned but rope_scale != 1.0. Also add a fast-path for common Qwen rotaries.

leo: opened issue #2387: "kernel-selector: preserve fused-GPU path for Qwen head_dim+rope_scale combos" with repro, profile, and flamegraphs attached. tagging runtime and ml-infra.

jen: ops question — can we roll the rollout back to 0% until this is resolved? current 10% still hitting prod.

infra-bot: rollback request acknowledged. rollback window starts in 5m if no objections.

maria: action items:
- aj to draft selector patch + unit test for head_dim/rope_scale combos (ETA EOD)
- leo to run full e2e regression suite against revert config (ETA tomorrow AM)
- jen to coordinate rollback if reproduction confirmed on prod traffic (ETA now)
- sophie will try tuning eviction thresholds and measure cost impact (ETA today)

aj: also adding a short-term runtime flag `force_gpu_kv_path_forced=true` per-model so product can opt-out of fp8/host-KV if needed. keeping it gated behind admin feature flag.

sophie: note: if we force GPU path we might increase VRAM usage ~5-7% since we keep more KV on GPU; trading latency for memory. I'll add numbers to the ticket.

maria: thanks. leaving traces and config diffs in the thread: https://internal.reports/perf/1815000000 and repro gist: https://gist.internal/qwen-repro-1815

leo: final note — we should add prefix-priority eviction: keep earliest N tokens in GPU KV (prefix-only) to avoid host-copy on conversation resumption. I'll prototype a scheduler tweak after the selector fix.

jen: copying legal/infra for any compliance concerns when toggling model overrides.

maria: pinging on the rollback now — will post final metrics after rollback completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
